name: token-meter
description: Shows the tokens each turn used, and what they cost at list price, right under its prompt and its last reply

cacheTtl.title: Cache write duration
cacheTtl.description: How long Claude Code keeps prompts in the cache, which sets the cache write price (5m: 1.25x input, 1h: 2x input). auto follows Claude Code: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m otherwise, unless an environment variable or the promptCacheTtl setting says otherwise.
